verse: Ye are the light of the world.... Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven. Matthew 5:14-16.
title: Small Acts, Shining Light
bullets: Your daily life lived in faith speaks louder than words ever could, as a godly example silences arguments that logic alone cannot overcome.
Don't wait for a prominent position to share your faith—visit neighbors, serve faithfully in small ways, and let your consistent virtue uncover the precious truths of God's Word.
By working unselfishly for others and keeping your soul alive through active service, you gather sheaves for Jesus and honor His name in every circumstance.
prayer: Lord, help me stop waiting for opportunities to shine and simply let my light shine where I am right now through my daily faithfulness and love. Give me courage to witness quietly through my actions and to find joy in serving others in whatever humble ways come before me. Amen.
